initialPrompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit.
Asset type: corrected photorealistic kitchen NIGHT preview, image only.
Input 1 is the photoreal edit target. Inputs 2 and 3 are the client's exact WINDOW WALL and RO WALL elevation layouts. These elevations govern module boundaries; never reproduce their text. Keep same perspective camera, architecture, window and its two panes, L counter outline, fridge, colour palette and night illumination.
Correct the THREE specific failures without introducing new geometry mistakes:
A. EXHAUST SHUTTER strictly within the width of the RIGHT WINDOW PANE. Its left side aligns with the central window mullion, right side aligns with the window's right jamb. It must END at that jamb and must not extend past it into the chimney cupboard. In input1 the exhaust service shutter wrongly extends to the right past the window; remove that overhang, recompose it FLUSH within its own upper module. Keep the enlarged louvre grille inset within that right-pane-width shutter, with a single silver access handle above grille. Closed and coplanar with adjacent cabinetry, no projecting box lip. Do not change window or enlarge chimney. There is a precise thin vertical joint between this service shutter and the chimney module at the window jamb. No grille or shutter overlap on chimney or window glass.
B. CHIMNEY CABINET immediately to the RIGHT of window has ONE continuous full-width lift-up lower shutter, NOT two cupboard doors. Remove all centre splits and paired side-opening doors. Show this ONE unbroken front panel lifted upward about 45 degrees, hinged along its top edge, with two side stays and ONE centrally placed silver handle. A single full-width panel above the hood, not two leaves. Keep hood/extractor filters and small task lights directly above the four-burner hob. Keep the upper loft over it a single door too, as drawn in window elevation. Cabinet vertical boundaries remain at window jamb and corner. This hood panel must never cross onto the window or exhaust service shutter.
C. SINK BASE on RO WALL: the ENTIRE double-bowl sink width sits directly ABOVE TWO full-height hinged walnut cupboard doors, not above any drawers. Align the left edge of the sink-base door pair with the OUTSIDE LEFT EDGE of sink assembly and the right edge with its OUTSIDE RIGHT EDGE. There must be NO drawer beneath EITHER bowl, not even partly under left bowl. Shorten the walnut drawer stack to the LEFT of sink so it ends before sink left edge. To RIGHT of sink base is a LIGHT three-drawer stack under RO bay before fridge. Keep mini geyser in RIGHT HALF of sink cupboard; show right door open for its inspection, compact geyser set back below bowls with tidy waste plumbing and unit connections; left sink cupboard door closed. Do not put heater beside sink or replace it with drawers.
Reproduce all module sequences exactly:
WINDOW WALL left to right: two light three-drawer stacks, ONE wide walnut three-drawer stack under window, one narrower walnut three-drawer stack under left part of hob, ONE full-height walnut CORNER ACCESS DOOR under right part of hob at window-wall end. Keep that corner door open, exposing EXACTLY ONE fixed shelf extending into deep corner, no rotating or pull-out trays. This opening faces the same way as window-wall drawers.
RO WALL from corner to fridge: walnut three-drawer stack ending at sink LEFT edge, the two sink cupboard doors spanning both bowls, light three-drawer stack beginning at sink RIGHT edge, fridge. No corner opening on RO wall.
Over sink: dish drying rack OUTSIDE width exactly equal to complete two-bowl sink outside width and centered over both bowls. One full-width lift-up rack shutter shown open, not paired panels, stainless plate/cup racks and drip tray inside. Immediately RIGHT is narrower concealed RO cupboard, with closed shutter and finished cut-out showing its BUILT-IN dispensing tap/lever and glass space; body hidden. Only main mixer tap on sink.
All corresponding drawer tier heights align: shallow top row and two matching deeper rows, continuous level across each straight run. Ceiling-height two-tier sand upper cabinets, equal thin joinery reveals, no broad blank filler/spacer blocks, consistent handles. Preserve clear central floor, no dining furniture or separate handwash.
Night only, no sunlight or leaf shadows. Recessed ceiling downlights, warm-neutral 3000K concealed continuous undercabinet task lighting and hood task lights. Matte floor with subdued reflections. High-quality realistic architectural interior render; no people, labels, watermark, text. Accurate module boundaries and practical access take precedence over decoration.
targetedCorrectionPrompt:
Precise correction edit of Image 1, a photorealistic night-time L-shaped Indian modular kitchen. Preserve camera, architecture, window position/size, countertops, sink, rack, RO, fridge, materials, lighting and all other objects. Edit only these cabinetry details:
1. Above the RIGHT WINDOW PANE, the exhaust service shutter and its grille must end exactly at the RIGHT WINDOW JAMB, never beyond it into the chimney module. In this 1536x1024 reference the window central mullion is approximately x394 and outer right jamb is approximately x543. The current exhaust panel runs too far right, to x571. Move that entire cabinet dividing boundary back LEFT to the right window jamb x543; move its left boundary to align with the central mullion. Keep the shutter flush, in the same plane as adjacent cabinet fronts. Reduce the grille to fit wholly inside this single shutter with a handle ABOVE it; no protruding box or lip over the hood.
2. The concealed chimney cabinet immediately RIGHT of the window has ONE unbroken upper loft shutter, with ONE central handle; remove the central vertical joint between its current two upper loft doors. Preserve the ONE broad lower lift-up hood service shutter shown open, no paired cupboard doors. Hood grille below belongs only to this module, no overlap with exhaust shutter.
3. Under the window, merge the TWO adjacent wide walnut drawer columns into ONE wide three-drawer column spanning the window zone. Delete their central vertical seam and duplicate handles: each of the three tiers has ONE centered horizontal handle. Preserve the separate narrow walnut three-drawer column immediately to its right under the left side of the hob, then the full-height corner access door at the window-wall end. Preserve two light three-drawer columns at the far left. All drawer tier heights align: shallow top, two deeper tiers.
All RO-wall base units must stay as existing: walnut three drawers completely LEFT of the sink; two full-height walnut doors under the COMPLETE double bowl sink, no drawers under either bowl; geyser behind the open right sink door; light three-drawer stack to sink right; fridge. Preserve one full-width lift-up dish rack shutter, direct RO tap visible through closed door cutout, four-burner hob and single fixed shelf in corner. No text, measurements or annotations in final image.

qa.method: Compared whole render and enlarged exhaust/chimney and sink regions to the two edited PowerPoint elevations.
findings: Exhaust grille remains inside its own shutter above the right window pane; service panel ends at the right jamb region and does not enter hood module.
Chimney lower shutter is one lift-up leaf; upper loft has one front.
Sink bowls have full-height cupboards beneath them; walnut drawers stop left of the bowls.
Window-wall wide walnut drawer bay is unsplit, followed by narrow hob-side drawers and corner access.
Three drawer tiers align across adjoining window-wall modules in perspective.
Corner is accessed through window-wall door, with one fixed shelf and no rotating or swing-out trays.
RO dispensing tap is accessible through closed shutter cutout; no separate countertop RO tap.
Mini geyser is concealed in the right sink cupboard; dish rack has a single lift-up shutter.
Consistent finishes, handles and thin cabinet reveals retained.

qa.perspective: Cook and household users aged 60+ and 28–35
qa.method: Whole night view and enlarged hob/preparation, sink/RO and hood/task-lighting regions.
findings: Four-burner hob retained below hood; two sink bowls and one mixer retained.
Preparation counter, adjacent washing area and direct RO dispensing remain visible.
Ceiling lights, hood lights and continuous under-cabinet task lights shown at night without sunlight.
Clear floor area, accessible base drawers and smooth cabinet fronts remain.
Open hood, corner and sink doors are shown for service-layout review.

limits: Visual concept review only. Exact cabinet widths, rack-to-sink dimensions, physical door clearances, appliance service requirements and light levels cannot be certified from a perspective raster render. PPT and 3D model unchanged.
